title: From Business Owner to Xero Certified in Six Weeks
excerpt: Maria, a café owner, needed bookkeeping skills for her own books and a new career path. Six weeks later she was Xero certified and landed her first client.
content:
Maria ran a café for nine years. When she decided to sell it, she wanted a skill she could turn into a career without starting from zero. Bookkeeping was the natural fit — she already understood invoices, suppliers and GST.

She enrolled in our Xero essentials course and set a six-week timeline: two evenings a week of structured lessons, plus a practice company she built from her café's real numbers.

Weeks one to two covered the chart of accounts, bank feeds and reconciliation. The moment it clicked for Maria was when she reconciled her own café accounts and found two months of unclaimed GST.

Weeks three to four: payroll, BAS preparation and reporting. Maria practised each week's content on a second practice company so her errors never touched real data.

Weeks five to six: the Xero certification exam and two mock client scenarios — a complete month-end close for a trades business and a BAS for a salon.

Maria passed the certification and, within a month, had signed her first bookkeeping client at $65 an hour.

Her advice: practice on your own real numbers. Rebuilding her café's books made every concept concrete, and it proved to her first client that she could handle a live business.
result: Xero certified in 6 weeks · first client at $65/hour
